# Enterprise GEO Observability (bgm352/enterprise-geo-observability)

> Programmatic framework and interactive telemetry dashboard for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), AI Share of Model (SoM) tracking, and Technical RAG Readiness auditing.

## Project Context
Created by Braydon Medlin (Senior Strategist, Search & Data Strategy). Designed to bridge traditional enterprise SEO and search intelligence with modern LLM citation and entity salience architecture.

## Key Modules
- `app.py`: Streamlit executive dashboard visualizing competitive AI visibility, citation share, and entity salience.
- `geo_engine.py`: Core scoring algorithms for Share of Model (SoM), Citation Rate, and `llms.txt` / JSON-LD readiness validation.
